title: Neighborhood pet-sitting marketplace (stripped)
idea: An app-based marketplace for booking short-notice pet care — walks and in-home sitting — from other residents of the same building or block. The person providing the care keeps 80% of the fee and the platform keeps 20%. Providers are screened with a government ID check and a recorded video introduction, and their first three bookings are free. There is no insurance partner; the owner accepts a liability waiver inside the app before booking. The initial rollout covers only vertical residential towers in a single metropolitan area.
focus_notes: Take-rate vs neighbor disintermediation (go off-app after intro)
